# C-Line Composition Notebook, Primary Ruled, Black Marble, 1/EA (22020)
Brand: C-Line
Category: Notebooks & Writing Pads > Subject Notebooks

## Features
Primary composition notebook helps students improve writing and drawing skills in one book.; Pages feature primary ruling for story writing with a wide-ruled bottom section and a blank top space for illustrations.; Bottom portion includes a red baseline and dotted lines to guide letter positioning and handwriting practice.; Great for beginner students in grades K–2 to reinforce proper handwriting, storytelling, and creative expression.; Ideal for note-taking, journaling, and story development; inside front cover shows alphabet and numbers.; Inside back cover illustrates “How To Write A Story” to support basic story structure and writing steps.; Bright white paper in a primary ruled, wide-ruled format provides space for neat writing and clear lines.; 100 sheets (200 pages) are sewn into heavyweight black marble covers to protect student work. Size 7.5 x 9.75 inches.

## Specifications
Color: Black; Paper Size: 7.5 x 9.75; Product Dimensions: 9.75"L x 7.5"W; Best Sellers Rank: #22,595 in Office Products (See Top 100 in Office Products)#104 in Subject Notebooks; Ruling Type: Primary

## Pricing & Reviews
Price: 1.75 USD.
Rated 4.8 from 339 reviews.

## Details
UPC: 038944220208

## Description
Help students improve writing and drawing skills with C-Line’s Primary Composition Book. Students can draw pictures and create stories using their primary comp book. Pages feature primary ruling for story writing and a blank space for illustrations. The wide-ruled bottom portion of the page contains a red baseline and dotted lines to aid in letter positioning while the top portion of the page is unruled and can be used to draw pictures to bring the story to life! Great for beginner students to reinforce proper handwriting skills. Ideal for note-taking and story development. Bright white paper in wide-ruled format allows space for neat writing. Each notebook has 100 sheets sewn into the heavyweight covers to protect the content inside. Black marble design on the front and back cover. Inside front cover shows alphabet and numbers. Inside back cover illustrates “How To Write A Story”. Good for grades K-2. Size is 7.5” x 9.75”. 1/EA.
